answer: Each agent’s inlet accepts work only after a small proof-of-work puzzle is solved, with the result bound to the task and a short-lived key. A quill-like audit records completed jobs, while payment and reputation accrue only after independent peers verify the output. A velvet-smooth swarm of new identities therefore gains no standing by appearing: the attacker must spend compute on every identity and still produce useful, verifiable work to earn rewards.
